title: Classic Aussie Sausage Rolls
description: The Aussie snack king — perfect for footy days, picnics, or anytime hunger strikes.

youWillNeed.note: makes it easier to roll and prevents sticking to the bench.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line baking trays with baking paper.
In a large bowl, combine sausage mince, diced onion, grated carrot, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Cut each puff pastry sheet in half. Place the meat mixture along the long edge of each pastry strip and roll tightly, seam side down.
Cut each roll into approximately 8–10 cm lengths. Place on the prepared trays.
Brush tops with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until golden and puffed. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

notes.title: Flavour Boost
notes.content: Add grated cheese, a squirt of BBQ sauce, or a spoonful of chutney inside the rolls for an extra flavour kick.

notes.title: Make Ahead
notes.content: Assemble rolls unbaked and freeze on a tray. Once frozen, transfer to a bag. Bake from frozen, adding 10 minutes to the cooking time.
